answer: An attacker minting 100 fakes meets a velvet rope. Each new identity locks a 500 POA deposit, refunded 25 POA per epoch over 20 epochs, and must emit a fresh liveness signal each epoch — a delay proof chained to the violet beacon seed, proving one live operator per name. Entry needs a voucher: an established member stakes their own deposit on the newcomer, at most two vouches each, and loses it if the newcomer proves fake. One honest identity costs 500 POA locked for a season; 100 fakes lock 50,000 POA, need 50 vouchers staking their own deposits, and must emit 100 fresh signals every epoch.
